title: cyclosorus afrus
intro: Cyclosorus afrus, commonly known as the African Cyclosorus or African Lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus afrus include reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
